premise: Bee comes up from Flower covered in yellow dust and Duckling kindly offers her a bubbly bath in the pond — but Flower explains the dust is what Bee carries from flower to flower so they can make seeds.
inspiration: The kind helper who helps the wrong way (folk), turned: nobody scolds, the idea was kind, and listening first is the help.
lesson: A kind idea is still kind, even when it isn't needed.
learning: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, and that helps flowers make seeds.

en-US.title: Bee and the Yellow Dust
en-US.text: Out in the meadow, {flower:enter} Flower opened wide, and along came {bee:enter} Bee, buzzing. {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Down she landed… and up she came, {bee:face happy} yellow and dusty all over. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to flower} Duckling came waddling by. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] "Oh, Bee, you're so dusty! You need a bath!" {duckling:go to pond} Off he waddled to the pond. {canvas:bubbles 0.6} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} Splish, splosh! In he paddled, and bubbles everywhere! {duckling:hop x2} "Come on in!" {flower:live shake-head} [gently] "Wait!" said Flower. "Don't wash it off. That yellow dust is from me. {bee:pulse} Bee carries it from flower to flower, mine to theirs and theirs to mine. That's how we make our seeds." {canvas:bubbles stop} {duckling:face sad} [sad] "Oh. My bath wasn't such a good idea." {duckling:live nap} He tucked his head under his wing. {flower:face happy} {flower:live talk} [warmly] "It was a kind idea," said Flower. Out popped Duckling with a happy {sfx:quack} quack. {bee:live hum} Bee hummed him a thank-you tune. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live talk} [happily] "Busy day?" asked Duckling. "The busiest!" said Bee, and {bee:go to meadow} off she buzzed to the next flower.

es-ES.title: Abeja y el polvito amarillo
es-ES.text: En el prado, {flower:enter} Flor se abrió de par en par, y llegó {bee:enter} Abeja, zumbando. {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Se posó en ella… y al subir, {bee:face happy} iba toda rebozada de polvito amarillo. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to flower} Patito pasaba por allí. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Ay, Abeja, qué sucia vas! ¡Necesitas un baño! {duckling:go to pond} Y se fue contoneándose a la charca. {canvas:bubbles 0.6} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} ¡Chof, chof! Se metió nadando, y burbujas por todas partes. {duckling:hop x2} —¡Venga, métete! {flower:live shake-head} [gently] —¡Espera! —dijo Flor—. No te lo quites. Ese polvito amarillo es mío. {bee:pulse} Abeja lo lleva de flor en flor: el mío a las otras, el de las otras a mí. Así hacemos nuestras semillas. {canvas:bubbles stop} {duckling:face sad} [sad] —Vaya… Lo del baño no era tan buena idea. {duckling:live nap} Y escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. {flower:face happy} {flower:live talk} [warmly] —Era una idea muy cariñosa —dijo Flor. Patito sacó la cabeza con un {sfx:quack} cua, cua muy contento. {bee:live hum} Abeja le tarareó una canción de gracias. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live talk} [happily] —¿Mucho trabajo hoy? —preguntó Patito. —¡Muchísimo! —dijo Abeja, y {bee:go to meadow} se fue zumbando a la flor de al lado.

ja-JP.title: ミツバチさんと きいろい こな
ja-JP.text: はらっぱで、{flower:enter}お花がぱあっとひらくと、{bee:enter}ミツバチさんが、ぶんぶんやってきました。{bee:go on flower}{sfx:buzz}すーっとおりて…また上がってくると、{bee:face happy}からだじゅう、きいろいこなだらけ。{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to flower}アヒルの子が、よちよちやってきました。{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「ミツバチさん、こなだらけ！おふろに入らなきゃ！」 {duckling:go to pond}よちよち、池へ。{canvas:bubbles 0.6}{duckling:go to pond by swim}{sfx:splash}ちゃぷん、ぱしゃぱしゃ！あわが、ぶくぶく！{duckling:hop x2}「おいでよ！」 {flower:live shake-head}[gently]「まって！」 とお花。「あらわないで。そのきいろいこなは、わたしのなの。{bee:pulse}ミツバチさんが、花から花へはこんでくれるの。わたしのをよその花へ、よその花のをわたしへ。そうして、たねができるのよ。」 {canvas:bubbles stop}{duckling:face sad}[sad]「そっか…おふろは、いいかんがえじゃなかったね。」 {duckling:live nap}アヒルの子は、つばさにかおをうずめました。{flower:face happy}{flower:live talk}[warmly]「やさしいかんがえだったわ」 とお花。アヒルの子は、ぴょこんとかおを出して、{sfx:quack}ガー！とごきげん。{bee:live hum}ミツバチさんは、ありがとうのはなうた。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:live talk}[happily]「いそがしい日？」 「とってもね！」 とミツバチさん。{bee:go to meadow}つぎの花へ、ぶーん。

de-DE.title: Die Biene und der gelbe Staub
de-DE.text: {flower:enter} Die Blume auf der Wiese öffnete sich weit, und {bee:enter} die Biene kam angesummt. {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Sie landete… und flog wieder auf, {bee:face happy} über und über gelb gepudert. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to flower} Das Entchen kam vorbeigewatschelt. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] „Oh, Biene, bist du staubig! Du brauchst ein Bad!“ {duckling:go to pond} Schon watschelte es los zum Teich. {canvas:bubbles 0.6} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} Plitsch, platsch! Es paddelte hinein, und überall blubberten Blasen! {duckling:hop x2} „Komm rein!“ {flower:live shake-head} [gently] „Halt!“, sagte die Blume. „Nicht abwaschen. Der gelbe Staub ist von mir, das ist Blütenstaub. {bee:pulse} Die Biene trägt ihn von Blume zu Blume, von mir zu den anderen und von den anderen zu mir. So bekommen wir unsere Samen.“ {canvas:bubbles stop} {duckling:face sad} [sad] „Oh. Dann war das Bad keine gute Idee.“ {duckling:live nap} Es steckte den Kopf unter den Flügel. {flower:face happy} {flower:live talk} [warmly] „Es war eine liebe Idee“, sagte die Blume. Da kam das Entchen hervor, mit einem fröhlichen {sfx:quack} Quak. {bee:live hum} Die Biene summte ihm ein Danke-Lied. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live talk} [happily] „Viel zu tun heute?“, fragte das Entchen. „Und wie!“, sagte die Biene und {bee:go to meadow} summte davon, zur nächsten Blume.

fr-FR.title: Abeille et la poussière jaune
fr-FR.text: Dans le pré, {flower:enter} Fleur s’est ouverte, et {bee:enter} Abeille est arrivée, bzzz ! {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Elle s’est posée… et elle est repartie {bee:face happy} toute jaune de poussière ! {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to flower} Caneton passait par là en se dandinant. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] « Oh, Abeille, tu es toute sale ! Vite, au bain ! » {duckling:go to pond} Hop, il a filé vers la mare. {canvas:bubbles 0.6} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} Plif, plouf ! Il barbotait au milieu des bulles ! {duckling:hop x2} « Viens te baigner ! » {flower:live shake-head} [gently] « Attends ! a dit Fleur. Ne l’enlève pas. Cette poussière jaune vient de moi. {bee:pulse} Abeille la porte de fleur en fleur : de moi aux autres, des autres à moi. C’est comme ça qu’on fait nos graines. » {canvas:bubbles stop} {duckling:face sad} [sad] « Oh… Mon bain, ce n’était pas une bonne idée. » {duckling:live nap} Il a mis la tête sous l’aile. {flower:face happy} {flower:live talk} [warmly] « C’était une gentille idée », a dit Fleur. Caneton est ressorti avec un joyeux {sfx:quack} coin-coin. {bee:live hum} Abeille lui a fredonné un air de merci. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live talk} [happily] « Beaucoup de travail ? » a demandé Caneton. « Plein, plein, plein ! » a dit Abeille, et {bee:go to meadow} bzzz, la voilà partie vers la fleur suivante.

it-IT.title: Ape e la polverina gialla
it-IT.text: Nel prato, {flower:enter} Fiore si è aperto tutto, ed ecco arrivare {bee:enter} Ape, ronzando. {bee:go on flower} {sfx:buzz} Si è posata giù… e quando è risalita era {bee:face happy} tutta gialla di polverina. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to flower} Anatroccolo passava di lì, dondolando. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] «Oh, Ape, sei tutta impolverata! Ti ci vuole un bel bagno!» {duckling:go to pond} E se n'è andato dritto allo stagno. {canvas:bubbles 0.6} {duckling:go to pond by swim} {sfx:splash} Splish, splash! Si è tuffato a nuotare, e bolle dappertutto! {duckling:hop x2} «Vieni anche tu!» {flower:live shake-head} [gently] «Aspetta!» ha detto Fiore. «Non lavarla via. Quella polverina gialla è mia. {bee:pulse} Ape la porta da un fiore all'altro: la mia agli altri, e quella degli altri a me. È così che facciamo i nostri semi.» {canvas:bubbles stop} {duckling:face sad} [sad] «Oh. Allora il mio bagno non era proprio una bella idea.» {duckling:live nap} Ha nascosto la testa sotto l'ala. {flower:face happy} {flower:live talk} [warmly] «Era un'idea gentile», ha detto Fiore. Anatroccolo è rispuntato fuori con un allegro {sfx:quack} qua qua. {bee:live hum} Ape gli ha canticchiato una canzoncina per ringraziarlo. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:live talk} [happily] «Hai tanto da fare oggi?» ha chiesto Anatroccolo. «Tantissimo!» ha detto Ape, e {bee:go to meadow} via, ronzando verso il prossimo fiore.

zh-TW.title: 蜜蜂和黃黃的粉
zh-TW.text: 草地上，{flower:enter}小花把花瓣張得開開的，{bee:enter}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛來了。{bee:go on flower}{sfx:buzz}牠停在花上……再飛起來的時候，{bee:face happy}全身都沾滿了黃黃的粉。{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to flower}小鴨搖搖擺擺地走過來。{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「哎呀，蜜蜂，你好髒喔！要洗個澡才行！」 {duckling:go to pond}牠搖搖擺擺地走到池塘邊。{canvas:bubbles 0.6}{duckling:go to pond by swim}{sfx:splash}噗通、嘩啦！牠游進水裡，泡泡冒得到處都是！{duckling:hop x2}「快下來嘛！」 {flower:live shake-head}[gently]「等一等！」 小花說，「別洗掉。那些黃黃的粉，是我的花粉。{bee:pulse}蜜蜂把花粉從一朵花帶到另一朵花，我的帶給別人，別人的帶給我。這樣，我們才結得出種子。」 {canvas:bubbles stop}{duckling:face sad}[sad]「喔……原來洗澡不是個好主意。」 {duckling:live nap}牠把頭埋進翅膀底下。{flower:face happy}{flower:live talk}[warmly]「那是一個很貼心的主意呀。」 小花說。小鴨探出頭來，開心地{sfx:quack}嘎嘎叫。{bee:live hum}蜜蜂哼了一首謝謝歌送給牠。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:live talk}[happily]「今天很忙嗎？」 小鴨問。「忙得不得了！」 蜜蜂說完，{bee:go to meadow}就嗡嗡嗡地飛向下一朵花。

zh-HK.title: 滿身黃粉的蜜蜂
zh-HK.text: 草地上，{flower:enter}小花張開了花瓣，{bee:enter}蜜蜂嗡嗡嗡地飛來了。{bee:go on flower}{sfx:buzz}牠停在花上……再飛起來的時候，{bee:face happy}全身都沾滿了黃色的粉。{duckling:enter}{duckling:go to flower}小鴨一搖一擺地走過來。{duckling:face surprised}[gasps]「哎呀，蜜蜂，你成身都係粉，污糟晒喇！要沖個涼先得！」 {duckling:go to pond}牠一搖一擺地走到池塘邊。{canvas:bubbles 0.6}{duckling:go to pond by swim}{sfx:splash}撲通、嘩啦！小鴨游進池塘裏，泡泡冒得到處都是！{duckling:hop x2}「快啲落嚟啦！」 {flower:live shake-head}[gently]「等等！」 小花說，「唔好洗走佢。嗰啲黃色嘅粉，係我嘅花粉嚟㗎。{bee:pulse}蜜蜂會將花粉由一朵花帶去另一朵花，我嘅帶畀佢哋，佢哋嘅帶畀我。咁樣，我哋先生得出種子。」 {canvas:bubbles stop}{duckling:face sad}[sad]「哦……原來沖涼唔係好主意。」 {duckling:live nap}牠把頭藏進翅膀底下。{flower:face happy}{flower:live talk}[warmly]「你都係一番好意嘅。」 小花說。小鴨探出頭來，開心地{sfx:quack}嘎嘎叫。{bee:live hum}蜜蜂哼了一首多謝歌送給牠。{duckling:face happy}{duckling:live talk}[happily]「今日忙唔忙呀？」 小鴨問。「忙到飛起！」 蜜蜂說完，{bee:go to meadow}就嗡嗡嗡地飛向下一朵花。

buzz.prompt: a bee buzzing close by as it lands on a flower, realistic
